title: Correction to: Expressing CaCCS encoding capsanthin/capsorubin synthase in tomato increases fruit provitamin A content and yield
content: This is a correction to: Jingwei Fu, Denise Tieman, Bala Rathinasabapathi, Expressing CaCCS encoding capsanthin/capsorubin synthase in tomato increases fruit provitamin A content and yield, Plant Physiology, Volume 200, Issue 3, March 2026, kiag062, https://doi.org/10.1093/plphys/kiag062
